mentions.name: ccTLD Technical Maturity Research
mentions.description: A personal research project analyzing the technical maturity of country-code top-level domains (ccTLDs). It currently draws on easily accessible public information, with results nearly ready to publish, and a next phase aimed at identifying markers of stack complexity such as provisioning.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm doing a personal research project into the technical maturity of ccTLDs. So far I've mostly been working with easily accessible public information, which I'm almost ready to publish, but the next phase is going to be trying to identify markers of stack complexity (provisioning etc) which is going to be tricky.
